claims.claim_text: Under sustained GNSS denial the diagnosis reports nominal for the entire fault window and never names gps_fault, while the GPS trust coefficient reads 0.9767.
The mechanism is structural: with the GPS physics feature gated out, no active feature distinguishes nominal from gps_fault, so their log posterior ratio equals the log prior ratio exactly.

An independent structural checker, importing no CSIA module and no part of the support-aware implementation, agrees with the production discriminating-term analysis on 378,000 of 378,000 tick-by-pair comparisons.
gps_fault|nominal is the only hypothesis pair in the deterministic scenario catalogue that ever becomes structurally indistinguishable.
The pair is also structurally indistinguishable for 76 ticks at the start of EVERY scenario, including clean flight, before the GPS physics gate opens.
Under GNSS fix loss the pair is additionally indistinguishable for 200 consecutive ticks (8.0 s at 25 Hz) starting at tick 625.
Smoothing changes threshold-crossing behaviour, and the direction and size of the change depend on the arm.
In the pre-onset window smoothing cuts threshold crossings from 36 to 9 out of 374 ticks, a 4x reduction in false crossings.
The CUSUM alarms earlier than the trust threshold in every faulted arm and never in the clean window.
No CUSUM novelty is claimed.
The general mechanism of fault-state-dependent observation loss is prior art and CSIA asserts no priority over it.
The behaviour is specific to faults that remove the GNSS fix; a position glitch that leaves the fix valid does not close the gate.
The residual detector saturates at the floor for every injected step from 5.6 m to 5.6 km and no step magnitude produces an alarm; the same total error as a ramp does.
q_gvalid = 0.984 over 3744 monitored ticks per arm; first gate closure 0.44 s after injection in every denial flight.
E_h subset-of C_h containment holds for gps_fault by inspection.
U_h subset-of C_h containment.
The WP-C8 mass-invariance 'theorem'.
R16, slow IMU bias detection.
'The campaign varied two axes.'

The normalized hypothesis weight is not confidence: a leader at high weight with zero discriminating evidence is reported as SUPPORT_LOST_FOR_REQUIRED_INFORMATION, not as eligibility. (Wording aligned 2026-09-04 with research/PAPER_CROSS_CONSISTENCY.md section A; the claim itself is unchanged.)
No observability claim is made. Receiver observables detect GNSS denial well; the failure measured is one of evidence routing and applicability semantics.
A public-log exposure study over PX4 Flight Review logs.

Mechanism A reproduced on the CURRENT ArduPilot 4.8 stack and on PX4 SIH, at N=1 fix-loss trial plus 1 matched fix-preserving control per platform, with the intervention validated by its downstream effect (RULE B) before scoring.

Mechanism B replicates on ArduPilot 4.8: given the platform's own measured banked state and measured per-tick evidence and forgetting factor, the source recursion reproduces the runtime trust trajectory and predicts the observed threshold crossing.
Mechanism B is INAPPLICABLE on PX4 SIH and was not tested there.

On 15,595 ticks from 20 real ArduPilot 4.8 SITL trials in which the GNSS fix was never lost, the structural predicate reports the nominal|gps_fault pair DISTINGUISHABLE at every tick and never collapses.
